sn50.1-12:1.1: The five powers are practically identical to the five spiritual faculties ([sn48.43]()). The 108 discourses in this Saṁyutta are merely stock passages and abbreviations. The analysis lacking here is found in a series of Suttas at [an5.13]()–16. | The Chinese version, representing the Sarvāstivāda Balasaṁyukta, gathers many of the discourses on different sets of “powers” that in the Pali are scattered about the canon. This is similar to the Indriyasaṁyutta, which likewise collects multiple different kinds of “faculties”. This is surely more likely to represent the original collection.
